QuestInfo.name: [Hilla] The Mysterious Mystic
QuestInfo.0: You hear beautiful singing from somewhere. A hooded figure approaches you.
QuestInfo.2: This wandering mystic told you of a rumor about the elixir of youth. Could it really be in Azwan?
QuestInfo.1: This wandering mystic told you of a rumor about the elixir of youth. Could it really be in Azwan? Go to #bAncient City Azwan#k.

0.0:
Fair Azwan! O, to live in the memories of the old kingdom. 
The foolish king, the beautiful women, even the late soldiers are gone. 
Only #beverlasting youth#k remains, for those bold enough to claim it!
0.1: Who am I? \r\nI am a wandering mystic, nothing more, peddling my song and dance. \r\nDid you hear my ballad of the #relixir of everlasting youth#k? It's quite a hit back in Ariant.
0.2: You look interested in the #relixir of everlasting youth#k.\r\nRumor has it that Hilla has left one somewhere in the ruins of Azwan.\r\nWith Hilla's army gone, it's a race to find it first. In fact, I hear that #bAreda, the Queen of Ariant#k, has already sent people on a mission to get it.
0.3: If you're interested, you should head to the #bancient kingdom of Azwan#k.

yes.0: Great! Be sure to tell me your story if you find that elixir.

no.0: How will you learn anything if you never try?

1.0: Have you come because of that #bWandering Mystic#k?
